notes: «قالا أخبرنا ابن وهب» — «قالا» makes Harun and Ahmad co-transmitters of one level.
«عن أبيه» is a bare relation link: the father of مخرمة is not named.
«زوج النبي» is an epithet of Aisha and is left out.

needs_ruling (rule 11): «قال فقلت للقاسم أفرأيت الحية قال تقتل بصغر لها» is an appended exchange with a first-person questioner and no isnad of its own; the text does not say whether al-Qasim is a link of this report.
